name: SambaNova Cloud
description: Open models on SambaNova's own RDU silicon, with a card-free rate-limited tier.
overview: SambaNova Cloud runs open weights on SambaNova's RDU chips behind an OpenAI-compatible API. The Free tier applies whenever no payment method is linked: every model gets 20 requests/minute, 20 requests/day and 200,000 tokens/day of its own, and no card is needed. Production models are DeepSeek V3.1, Llama 3.3 70B and gpt-oss-120b; DeepSeek V3.2 and Gemma 4 31B are evaluation-only previews. Linking a card moves the account to the metered Developer tier instead.
free_access: No card required for the Free tier
Production and preview models both included
notes: The binding limit is 20 requests/day per model; preview models can be withdrawn at short notice.
